errors.text_span: които са числови и без единици
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the values are without units. The chart displays the Gini Coefficient, which is commonly expressed as a percentage, and the reference description correctly identifies the units as percentages.

errors.text_span: като за България намалението е по-съществено
errors.evidence: This statement, which translates to 'the reduction for Bulgaria is more substantial', is factually incorrect. For every year in the chart, the reduction in the Gini coefficient after social transfers is smaller for Bulgaria than for the EU. For example, in 2016 the reduction for the EU is 5.1 (35.7-30.6), while for Bulgaria it is 2.6 (40.3-37.7).
The description states the legend is in the top-left corner, but it is located at the top center of the chart area.
